name: Paddock Finance
description: Paddock is the data layer for AI agent commerce. It tracks real on-chain payments between AI agents — what services they buy, which categories are concentrating, and where the market is opening up. This connector gives Claude live access to the agent-commerce market: a current market summary (transaction volume, active agents, top spending categories) and per-category detail (services, transaction counts, provider concentration, reliability scores). Data is refreshed continuously from on-chain x402 transactions on Base and Solana, cross-referenced against service registries. Free, neutral, and citable.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Paddock Finance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Paddock Finance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://paddock.finance/api/mcp/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Paddock Finance MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paddock Finance provides these MCP tools: get_market_summary, get_category_detail, agent-commerce, e.g, readOnlyHint, and data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Paddock Finance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Paddock Finance in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Paddock Finance MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paddock Finance does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Paddock Finance is developed by Autumn Sun LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
